AGIBOT and Vietnam NIC launch robotics education and service initiatives

A Hanoi conference connected education, research labs and robot services to support Vietnam’s embodied AI ecosystem.

AGIBOT / PR Newswire ↗2 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

Building local capacity

AGIBOT and Vietnam’s National Innovation Center held a Hanoi conference on October 2, 2026 with ECOLIV and Great Education. The company reported more than 550 participants representing over 50 educational institutions and more than 20 research organizations. The initiative focuses on skills and the support needed to put robots to work locally.

Education meets robot services

The YuanSheng program connects teaching and research through curriculum development, shared laboratories, faculty training and student practice. A Robot-as-a-Service offering involves ECOLIV in local project delivery and after-sales support. The event displayed humanoid, quadruped and wheeled platforms for education and industrial applications.

What remains to be demonstrated

Combining imported robotics technology with local skills and service providers is relevant to automation adoption across Southeast Asia. Education, retail, hospitality and manufacturing are target sectors. The announcement does not establish a commercial installed fleet or measured customer returns in Vietnam; these remain outcomes to watch as the initiatives develop.
